data.name: StatusInitial
data.value: Select a .compiler_settings file and click Analyze.

data.name: DescStale
data.value: Dead references in the settings file's tag lists: entries pointing at files or folders that no longer exist, and duplicates. Removing them never changes what gets compiled. Checked entries are removed when you apply.

data.name: DescRedundant
data.value: Mods still in the list whose Always Enabled tag currently does nothing, because the mod is enabled in every selected profile that lists it. (A mod disabled in even one selected profile is not shown — there the tag preserves that profile's disabled line.) Checking a mod removes its tag when you apply; keep the tag if you might disable the mod later.

data.name: DescDisabled
data.value: Mods that are disabled in every selected profile. Wabbajack skips them unless you mark them Always Enabled (their files ship, still disabled, for users to opt into).

data.name: DescNoDownload
data.value: Mods that will be compiled but can't be traced to a download archive. Their files must be inlined into the modlist: Include embeds them unconditionally; No match include embeds only what nothing else matches (the usual choice for generated content). Each row shows the mod's current tag; change the dropdown to retag or untag it.

data.name: RedundantReasonFmt
data.value: Mod '{0}' is enabled in every selected profile that lists it, so the tag currently has no effect.

data.name: RemoveAETagAccessibleFmt
data.value: Remove the Always Enabled tag from {0}

data.name: NotListedNote
data.value: Not listed in any selected profile's modlist.txt.

data.name: ReasonNoMetaIni
data.value: No meta.ini — likely a hand-created or generated mod folder.

data.name: ReasonArchiveNotFoundFmt
data.value: Installed from '{0}', which is not in the downloads folder.

data.name: OverlapDiffPartFmt
data.value: {0} also exist in downloaded mods (stored as binary diffs)

data.name: OverlapConfigPartFmt
data.value: {0} are config/text files Wabbajack always inlines

data.name: OverlapAllFmt
data.value: ⚑ All {0} file(s) are handled without a tag: {1}. A tag isn't strictly needed (No match include is safe insurance; avoid Include).

data.name: OverlapPartialFmt
data.value: ⚑ {0} of {1} files are handled without a tag ({2}) — {3} unique file(s) still need inlining (e.g. {4}); No match include recommended.

data.name: WarnProfileNotFoundFmt
data.value: Profile '{0}' from the settings file has no profiles\{0}\modlist.txt in the instance.

data.name: WarnNoProfiles
data.value: None of the selected profiles were found; disabled-mod and download checks are limited.

data.name: WarnDownloadsWithoutMetaFmt
data.value: {0} file(s) in the downloads folder have no .meta sidecar; Wabbajack will try to infer their source or ignore them.

data.name: WarnUnknownArchiveMetasFmt
data.value: {0} download .meta file(s) are marked unknownArchive=true; compilation fails if any matched file needs them.

data.name: StatusNothingToClean
data.value: Analysis complete: nothing to clean up.

data.name: StatusAnalysisSummaryFmt
data.value: Analysis complete: {0} stale entries, {1} redundant Always Enabled tags, {2} disabled mods, {3} mods without a download.

data.name: SettingsThemeNote
data.value: System follows the Windows app mode. Changes apply immediately and are remembered.

data.name: AboutDescription
data.value: A cleanup tool for Wabbajack modlist authors. A supplement to Wabbajack, not a replacement — compile your list in Wabbajack itself. MIT licensed.
